ResearchProjectDef.label: justiciar gear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Forge the eltex-laced arms and armor of the imperial justiciars: the Promachos helmet and armor, the energy psy-spear and psyblade, and the warlockbane shield.\n\nThe Empire guards these designs closely. Their techprints can be bought from imperial traders, and imperial tomes sometimes hide them in their appendices.
